name: message-circle-warning
description: A round speech bubble containing an exclamation mark.
useCase: Show a messaging warning with an explanatory label.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The larger dot and aligned warning column remain clear beside text. The bubble closes with a continuous vertical tangent.

24.reason: The bubble has a continuous side tangent and clear interior spacing inside the square drawing frame.
